pairs.subject: stream-proxy-hop
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:110 The event stream proxy terminates upstream and wraps the response in a ReadableStream, but deviates across heartbeat sizing, abort classification, resume cursor forwarding, lifetime rotation, and error telemetry correlation.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:66 Classifies aborts by inspecting error shape rather than checking req.signal.aborted, and mid-stream drops close cleanly without a terminal error event.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:50 The outbound header allowlist attaches the service key and caller token but omits the Last-Event-ID resume cursor, losing replay on reconnect.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:119 Heartbeat interval is hardcoded inline at 25s rather than sized at half the shortest idle timeout in a named constant, and lacks anti-buffering headers.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:19 The route declares no maxDuration lifetime cap and implements no proactive rotation before platform execution limits expire.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:75 The error response scrubs the upstream host but fails to generate or return an opaque correlation handle for telemetry lookup.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:130 The upstream read loop awaits chunks without a byte-progress lease watchdog to detect stalled upstream transfers.
src/components/dashboard/views/events/index.tsx:41 Mounted stream consumer uses backoff without jitter that resets immediately on open, with an indicator lacking attempt counts or a failed state.
src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:89 Clamps upstream status to 200-599 before constructing Response, but lacks a cause taxonomy and an explicit retryability flag.

pairs.registryProposal: Clarify in upstream-status-normalization that native EventSource sets readyState to CLOSED without retrying on non-200 handshake statuses per the W3C/HTML SSE specification; the infinite reconnect storm against 5xx is driven specifically by application-level onerror handlers (such as useEventStream) scheduling manual reconnect loops rather than the browser's built-in EventSource mechanism.
